material.description:
blocked_by: gap-mod-effects-reach-served-room (orient, remote main 60912eaa440bb47075a65a65ff79a1f085c66d3e)
fact: the mod effects cannot reach the served room through the allowed surface.
1. ModHost (rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs blob a4c8d1e3) keeps its command queue private: `cmds: Cmds = Rc<RefCell<Vec<Cmd>>>` with enum Cmd {Spawn,Order,Damage,Buff}; not pub, not reachable from server.
2. spawn_unit in bind_host writes the mod's private world immediately (no queue), so there is no pending list to read.
3. The only public door to the mod world is ModHost::sim() -> RefMut<Sim>. Sim exposes no public unit-kind accessor (kind is pub(crate), sim/src/arrays.rs), so a spawn cannot be replayed into the room with spawn_for(player, kind, x, y) from outside the sim crate.
4. ModLink (rust/crates/server/src/mods.rs blob f228fd4d) publishes only version and tick; room.rs (blob 0b567732) Clock owns a separate Sim with no hook for foreign effects.
Fixing it needs a mod-host change exposing pending commands or unit kind (outside this row's ownership), or a sim accessor (forbidden by the row). Neither was done; nothing pushed.
material.subject: Blocked: mod sim effects cannot reach the served room without mod-host or sim changes
material.witness: Served room g5 (oscraftd --room g5, mod spawns a skirmisher and orders its handle at tick 40) at f8ab064: ev=mod_unit_bound unit=30, the unit moved from 196608,196608 to 392452,261889, ev=mod_cmds applied=1. Output /tmp/gm-probe-17/out/g5-f8ab064.txt.
